$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema, for editors

version.description: The exact agent-os version this project is pinned to

profile.description: Where the project is in its life

platform.description: Which platform and project agent-os talks to

host.description: Base URL for GitHub Enterprise Server or GitLab self-managed; omit for github.com and gitlab.com

caFile.description: Private CA bundle for a self-managed host, relative to the repository

board.description: The planning board (GitHub Projects v2) issues are placed on, when there is one

owner.description: The user or organization that owns the board

integration.description: Feature PRs and MRs target this branch; it is the default branch

requiredChecks.description: Checks that must pass before merging into either branch

items.description: A check name, such as ci

requiredApprovals.description: Approving reviews required on pull or merge requests

mergeMethod.description: How /ship merges change requests into the integration branch

prefixes.description: Branch prefixes by issue type (feature, bug, docs, chore, research), when the team uses its own (feature/, bugfix/); /discover proposes them

additionalProperties.description: The branch prefix for this issue type

issues.description: Issue titles, bodies and comments the agent starts (en, or ro written without diacritics)

prs.description: Pull or merge request titles, descriptions and comments (en, or ro written without diacritics)

commits.description: Commit messages (en, or ro written without diacritics)

branches.description: Branch slugs (en, or ro written without diacritics)

labels.description: Label names and descriptions (en, or ro written without diacritics)

milestones.description: Milestone titles and descriptions (en, or ro written without diacritics)

releases.description: Release notes (en, or ro written without diacritics)

codeComments.description: Comments written in code (en, or ro written without diacritics)

docs.description: Human documentation in docs/ (en, or ro written without diacritics)

journal.description: Journal entries and decision records (en, or ro written without diacritics)

types.description: Allowed types in change-request titles and commit subjects

maxTitleLength.description: Longest change-request title or commit subject, issue suffix included

exempt.description: Titles exempt from the checks (syncs, bots)

items.description: A regular expression; matching titles are not checked

packs.description: Optional packs installed in this project

slots.description: Capability slots and the skills bound to them

additionalProperties.description: The skill bound to this slot, or null for none

gate.description: Test and check suites by name

additionalProperties.description: The command that runs this suite

standards.description: Mechanical standards checks (on edit and in doctor)

maxFileLines.description: Remind when a code file grows past this many lines

exclude.description: Paths agent-os test gaps leaves out

items.description: A path prefix or glob that needs no tests (generated code, vendored files)

map.description: Source globs and where their tests live ("src/**/*.ts": ["{dir}/{name}.test.ts"]); files no glob matches use the built-in naming rules

items.description: Where its test lives: a path with {dir}, {name} and {ext}, e.g. "{dir}/{name}.test.{ext}"

gateAffected.description: Affected components in a monorepo: only the components a change touches, and those that depend on them, are tested

command.description: The command that tests one component, with {id}, {path} and {name}, e.g. "pnpm --filter ./{path} test"; the gate runs it for each affected component

gateLayers.description: Stack layers and the gate suites a change to them needs ("data-layer": ["migrations"]), matched through the layer paths in stack.yaml

gatePaths.description: Path globs and the gate suites a change to them needs ("docs/**": ["docs"]); without it every suite runs

requires.description: What a working setup needs, checked by agent-os env

name.description: Server name as registered in Claude Code

url.description: http/sse: the server URL, used in the fix command

command.description: stdio: the command that starts the server, used in the fix command

optional.description: A missing optional server is a warning, not a failure

additionalProperties.description: A semver range, or * for any version

platformScopes.description: Token scopes the platform CLI needs

env.description: Variables that must be set (values are never read)

enabled.description: Allow /upstream to file issues on the public agent-os repository (default: on, off on a self-managed host)

security.description: Security: the advisory watch and accepted risks

enabled.description: Let the advisory watch ask OSV.dev and CISA KEV about package names and versions (default: on, off on a self-managed host)

osvUrl.description: An OSV-compatible querybatch endpoint, e.g. an internal mirror

kevUrl.description: Where the CISA KEV catalog (JSON) is read from, e.g. an internal mirror

scanners.description: Scanners the team runs; agent-os env reports the missing ones (agent-os never installs or runs them)

items.description: A scanner command, e.g. gitleaks, osv-scanner, semgrep

reports.description: Scanner reports the security pass reads

items.description: A path to a scanner report (SARIF or gitleaks JSON)

acceptedRisks.description: Advisories the owners accepted in writing; the release gate lets them through

id.description: The advisory id (GHSA-…, CVE-…, OSV id)

euOnly.description: Flag providers without confirmed EU regions

contextBudgets.description: Size budgets per file or glob

legacy.description: Legacy features this project keeps enabled

guards.description: Guards that refuse risky shell commands before they run (PreToolUse)

rules.description: Project guard rules, added to the built-in ones

id.description: A short name, shown when the rule refuses something

pattern.description: A regular expression matched against each shell command (after splitting on && || ; |)

flags.description: forbid-flags: flags refused after a matching command

env.description: require-env: the variable that must be set, e.g. DB_RESET_OK=1 in the command or the environment

message.description: What to tell the agent when the rule refuses

disable.description: Built-in guards turned off for this project

items.description: The id of a built-in guard

npmRegistry.description: The npm registry (an internal mirror) agent-os is installed from; passed to npx and to the generated CI jobs

maxPageKb.description: doctor warns when an artifact page is larger than this

siteUrl.description: Where the artifact site is published (e.g. https://acme.github.io/app); artifact link adds it after the repository link

pages.description: Install the workflow that publishes artifacts to GitHub or GitLab Pages (the index is built in CI, never committed)

ci.description: How generated CI jobs run: image and runners

image.description: The container image generated CI jobs run in, e.g. from the internal registry (default node:22)

tags.description: Runner tags for generated CI jobs (GitLab tags; GitHub runs-on labels)

loop.description: Install the agent-os/loop job (turn it off only when the project's own CI already runs agent-os check loop)

gate.description: Install the agent-os/gate job (turn it off only when the project's own CI already runs agent-os gate)

retro.description: Install the weekly scheduled job that keeps the Retro issue current

labels.description: Install the workflow that keeps labels in step with agent-os.json and stack.yaml (needs a token that may write labels)

securityWatch.description: Install the scheduled job that keeps the Security digest issue current

labelsEnvironment.description: GitHub: the deployment environment the labels apply job runs in (to require approval or scope its secret)

adoption.description: Adoption mode for projects new to agent-os

warnOnlyUntil.description: Until this date (YYYY-MM-DD) guards only warn instead of refusing

cutoff.description: Forward-only: doctor ignores issues and journal entries older than this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
